name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: The 39% is the number that matters here, down from 80%+ in 2023-25. Custom silicon at 24% for Broadcom isn't a footnote anymore. JPMorgan's split, not mine.

54% by 2027 would make custom silicon the majority of AI shipments, not a niche. The Google TPU deal running to 2031 gives Broadcom a long runway here. Supply-chain details are still thin, though, and NVDA reports Tuesday. That will be the next real read on AI demand.

These are one account's estimates, not Broadcom's own numbers, so take the $50B with a grain of salt. Unit cost isn't the whole TPU story, packaging and yields count too. If the gap is anywhere near this wide, it's a fair question for Google's next refresh.

That ~$50B is doing a lot of work — it's the per-chip gap ($8,434 vs $16,996) times a 6M-unit lifecycle, with HBM doing most of it. If volumes or HBM pricing move, the headline number moves with them.
高盛测算，到2028年AI基建支出约3.8万亿美元，其中博通相关约8760亿，占21%，对应部署规模占31%。每GW成本约250亿，不到英伟达一半，2026-2028年部署量预计从5GW增至20GW。定制芯片省钱的账，超大规模客户越算越清楚。这只是投行测算，不是公司指引。 $AVGO
四半期推移で見ると、xPUとNetworkingの伸びがはっきりしている。需要側の勢いは続いているが、株価は50日線（$345.38）すれすれまで押された。来週の終値が試金石になる。

Friday explains a lot of it. Redburn cut to Neutral with a $398 target and the stock fell 4.76% to $347.01. Consensus is still Moderate Buy at a $525.19 average, so this looks more like a re-rating than a broken growth story.
Redburn 把博通从 Buy 砍到 Neutral，目标价 595→398，周五跌了 4.8%。砍的不是订单，是 AI 收入的质量：Anthropic 和 OpenAI 能不能自己造血。另一边 Anthropic IPO 认购了约 6 倍，市场还在给算力大买家掏钱。砍完的 398 仍比收盘 347 高 15%，分歧就摆在这了。$AVGO

A sharp cut, but $398 is still above Thursday's $364.36 close, and it's the low one in your table: JPM and BofA both reiterated Buy on 11/9. The split among analysts matters more than any single target. Dec 9 earnings are the next checkpoint for the financing question.

TSMC putting $500M behind chip startups, and maybe suppliers for the first time, is the supply chain betting on itself. The next Broadcom gets built, not bought. Worth watching who the fund actually backs. $AVGO

The re-rating case is really about the mix: custom silicon plus the networking that ties it together. $16.7B in AI semis, up 221%, is the number that has to keep compounding. December 9 is when margins get checked. $AVGO

The Broadcom angle is the interesting part here. A scaled MRVL-LITE gives Nvidia a counterweight without owning the fabs, but Cisco and Arista won't love a captive stack, and SAMR gets 18-24 months to weigh in.
收 364.36，四连涨，五个交易日涨了快 12%。50 日线 345.59 踩在脚下了，上面就是 200 日线 367.34。量也放出来了，RSI 59.5，还没到过热。接下来就看 200 日线能不能站住，12 月 9 号财报是下一关。$AVGO
